rows.text: The Company’s pioneering and voluntary adoption of the TCFD Recommendations since 2017 provides climate-related financial information for ESG investors to make informed investment decisions.
rows.source_sentence: The Company’s pioneering and voluntary adoption of the TCFD Recommendations since 2017 provides climate-related financial information for ESG investors to make informed investment decisions.

rows.text: The findings of our 2023 materiality assessment revealed that “Climate Resilience and Adaptation” remains one of our top three material ESG issues.
rows.source_sentence: The findings of our 2023 materiality assessment revealed that “Climate Resilience and Adaptation” remains one of our top three material ESG issues.

rows.text: CDL is proud to be one of the first few companies in Singapore to have adopted TCFD reporting in 2017, and has been consistently expanding our level of disclosure since.
rows.source_sentence: CDL is proud to be one of the first few companies in Singapore to have adopted TCFD reporting in 2017, and has been consistently expanding our level of disclosure since.

rows.text: Climate resilience and adaptation remained one of the Group’s top three material topics in 2023.
rows.source_sentence: Climate resilience and adaptation remained one of the Group’s top three material topics in 2023.

rows.text: The Group’s carbon mitigation strategy has been largely focused on addressing Scope 2 emissions as electricity usage forms the largest source of emissions for our core operations in Singapore.
rows.source_sentence: The Group’s carbon mitigation strategy has been largely focused on addressing Scope 2 emissions as electricity usage forms the largest source of emissions for our core operations in Singapore.

rows.text: In December 2023, the Company became the first Singapore corporate to secure the OCBC 1.5°C loan, Singapore’s first net-zero-aligned loan for corporates to drive the transition to a low carbon economy.
rows.source_sentence: In December 2023, the Company became the first Singapore corporate to secure the OCBC 1.5°C loan, Singapore’s first net-zero-aligned loan for corporates to drive the transition to a low carbon economy.

rows.text: The Company is dedicated to strengthening the climate resiliency of our portfolio by setting targets towards carbon mitigation and environmental protection.
rows.source_sentence: The Company is dedicated to strengthening the climate resiliency of our portfolio by setting targets towards carbon mitigation and environmental protection.

rows.text: Our net-zero commitment covers Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions and includes different phases of strategic action required by key stakeholders, to tackle the transition process identified under each scope.
rows.source_sentence: Our net-zero commitment covers Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions and includes different phases of strategic action required by key stakeholders, to tackle the transition process identified under each scope.

rows.text: The team explores innovative carbon reduction solutions and partnerships in tandem with the Company’s Enterprise Innovation Committee, formed in 2018 to promote cross-departmental collaboration to accelerate the Group’s innovation journey.
rows.source_sentence: The team explores innovative carbon reduction solutions and partnerships in tandem with the Company’s Enterprise Innovation Committee, formed in 2018 to promote cross-departmental collaboration to accelerate the Group’s innovation journey.

rows.text: In 2018, we were the first real estate company in Singapore to set carbon emissions reduction targets validated by the SBTi based on a 2°C warmer scenario.
rows.source_sentence: In 2018, we were the first real estate company in Singapore to set carbon emissions reduction targets validated by the SBTi based on a 2°C warmer scenario.

rows.text: In 2021, we stepped up our decarbonisation commitment with more ambitious SBTi-validated targets, aligned with a 1.5°C scenario.
rows.source_sentence: In 2021, we stepped up our decarbonisation commitment with more ambitious SBTi-validated targets, aligned with a 1.5°C scenario.

rows.text: The revised SBTi-validated targets also support our WorldGBC Net Zero Carbon Buildings Commitment.
rows.source_sentence: The revised SBTi-validated targets also support our WorldGBC Net Zero Carbon Buildings Commitment.

rows.text: The Company was the first real estate conglomerate in Southeast Asia to sign the commitment in February 2021 to achieve net-zero operational carbon by 2030.
rows.source_sentence: The Company was the first real estate conglomerate in Southeast Asia to sign the commitment in February 2021 to achieve net-zero operational carbon by 2030.

rows.text: The Company has since extended our pledge towards a net-zero whole life carbon-built environment, including reducing embodied carbon.
rows.source_sentence: The Company has since extended our pledge towards a net-zero whole life carbon-built environment, including reducing embodied carbon.

rows.text: Through this expanded commitment, new and existing wholly-owned assets under our direct management and operational control, will operate at net-zero carbon and achieve maximum embodied carbon reduction in new developments, compensating for any remaining residual operational and upfront embodied emissions via offsetting by 2030.
rows.source_sentence: Through this expanded commitment, new and existing wholly-owned assets under our direct management and operational control, will operate at net-zero carbon and achieve maximum embodied carbon reduction in new developments, compensating for any remaining residual operational and upfront embodied emissions via offsetting by 2030.

rows.text: Commit to achieving net-zero operational carbon for new and existing wholly-owned assets under direct operational and management control.
rows.source_sentence: Commit to achieving net-zero operational carbon for new and existing wholly-owned assets under direct operational and management control.

rows.text: Maximise reduction in embodied carbon and compensate for any residual upfront emissions via offsetting for new developments and major renovations.
rows.source_sentence: Maximise reduction in embodied carbon and compensate for any residual upfront emissions via offsetting for new developments and major renovations.

rows.text: Measure and publicly disclose Scope 1 and 2 emissions, embodied carbon emissions and energy consumption by assessing annual asset and portfolio energy demand and carbon emissions against set targets.
rows.source_sentence: Measure and publicly disclose Scope 1 and 2 emissions, embodied carbon emissions and energy consumption by assessing annual asset and portfolio energy demand and carbon emissions against set targets.

rows.text: Reduce energy consumption for construction and operations of assets, by implementing energy efficiency measures and transition to 100% renewable energy via on-site production or procurement of clean energy, e.g., Renewable Energy Certificates.
rows.source_sentence: Reduce energy consumption for construction and operations of assets, by implementing energy efficiency measures and transition to 100% renewable energy via on-site production or procurement of clean energy, e.g., Renewable Energy Certificates.

rows.text: Adopt sustainable building designs, materials and supply chain practices to reduce upfront embodied carbon and offset any residual upfront emissions.
rows.source_sentence: Adopt sustainable building designs, materials and supply chain practices to reduce upfront embodied carbon and offset any residual upfront emissions.

rows.text: Verify and report lifecycle assessment for embodied carbon at asset level for new developments.
rows.source_sentence: Verify and report lifecycle assessment for embodied carbon at asset level for new developments.

rows.text: Engage and influence value chain and building users to support and build towards a wider transition to a net-zero whole life carbon-built environment.
rows.source_sentence: Engage and influence value chain and building users to support and build towards a wider transition to a net-zero whole life carbon-built environment.

rows.text: By 2030, all new buildings, infrastructure and renovations will have at least 40% less embodied carbon with significant upfront carbon reduction and all new buildings will be net-zero operational carbon.
rows.source_sentence: By 2030, all new buildings, infrastructure and renovations will have at least 40% less embodied carbon with significant upfront carbon reduction and all new buildings will be net-zero operational carbon.

rows.text: By 2050, new buildings, infrastructure and renovations will have net-zero embodied carbon and all buildings, including existing buildings must be net-zero operational carbon.
rows.source_sentence: By 2050, new buildings, infrastructure and renovations will have net-zero embodied carbon and all buildings, including existing buildings must be net-zero operational carbon.

rows.text: This assessment determines the key economic, environmental, social and governance (EESG) issues that are important to our stakeholders.
rows.source_sentence: This assessment determines the key economic, environmental, social and governance (EESG) issues that are important to our stakeholders.

rows.text: With the urgency of the global energy transition, “Energy Efficiency and Adoption of Renewables” rose to become the top materiality issue in 2023, followed by “Climate Resilience and Adaptation” and “Innovation”.
rows.source_sentence: With the urgency of the global energy transition, “Energy Efficiency and Adoption of Renewables” rose to become the top materiality issue in 2023, followed by “Climate Resilience and Adaptation” and “Innovation”.

rows.text: The Board is responsible for the governance of risk across the Group, while ensuring that Management maintains a sound system of risk management and internal controls.
rows.source_sentence: The Board is responsible for the governance of risk across the Group, while ensuring that Management maintains a sound system of risk management and internal controls.

rows.text: The Group recognises that climate risks are business risks.
rows.source_sentence: The Group recognises that climate risks are business risks.

rows.text: Aside from physical risks arising from climate change, regulatory transition risks can result in stricter emission standards, increased carbon tax and water pricing, and stricter building design requirements.
rows.source_sentence: Aside from physical risks arising from climate change, regulatory transition risks can result in stricter emission standards, increased carbon tax and water pricing, and stricter building design requirements.

rows.text: Beyond managing climate-related risks and opportunities under the ERM framework, the Company also manages operational risks pertaining to energy, water and supply of raw materials by adopting ISO management system standards that are internationally recognised and widely adopted.
rows.source_sentence: Beyond managing climate-related risks and opportunities under the ERM framework, the Company also manages operational risks pertaining to energy, water and supply of raw materials by adopting ISO management system standards that are internationally recognised and widely adopted.

rows.text: To align with globally-recognised standards in carbon emissions measurement and reporting, we became the first developer in Singapore in 2016 to validate our GHG emissions data against the stringent ISO 14064 certification in GHG emissions reporting.
rows.source_sentence: To align with globally-recognised standards in carbon emissions measurement and reporting, we became the first developer in Singapore in 2016 to validate our GHG emissions data against the stringent ISO 14064 certification in GHG emissions reporting.

rows.text: The verification covers stringent audits of processes on GHG emissions control and a review of emission factors used for diesel, petrol, refrigerant gases, electricity grid, transmission and distribution losses, employee commuting and business air travel.
rows.source_sentence: e assurance level, the verification covers stringent audits of processes on GHG emissions control and a review of emission factors used for diesel, petrol, refrigerant gases, electricity grid, transmission and distribution losses, employee commuting and business air travel.

rows.text: Electricity consumption has long been identified as a significant climate-related risk for the Company, as it forms the largest source of emissions for our core operations in Singapore (reported as Scope 2 emissions).
rows.source_sentence: Electricity consumption has long been identified as a significant climate-related risk for the Company, as it forms the largest source of emissions for our core operations in Singapore (reported as Scope 2 emissions).

rows.text: Key metrics include carbon emissions, embodied carbon, energy and water usage, and waste management, which are published in our quarterly reports and ISR.
rows.source_sentence: Key metrics include carbon emissions, embodied carbon, energy and water usage, and waste management, which are published in our quarterly reports and ISR.

rows.text: The Group has been disclosing Scope 1, 2 and 3 GHG emissions for our core operations and six key subsidiaries in our ISRs since 2015.
rows.source_sentence: The Group has been disclosing Scope 1, 2 and 3 GHG emissions for our core operations and six key subsidiaries in our ISRs since 2015.

rows.text: To ensure proper accounting of our GHG emissions, we scope our emission streams in accordance with the GHG Protocol Corporate Accounting and Reporting Standard.
rows.source_sentence: To ensure proper accounting of our GHG emissions, we scope our emission streams in accordance with the GHG Protocol Corporate Accounting and Reporting Standard.

rows.text: To further demonstrate our environmental practices’ alignment with international best practices, we were the first Singapore developer in 2016 to have our GHG emissions data, for our corporate office, industrial buildings, commercial buildings and development sites, externally validated against ISO 14064 on GHG verification.
rows.source_sentence: To further demonstrate our environmental practices’ alignment with international best practices, we were the first Singapore developer in 2016 to have our GHG emissions data, for our corporate office, industrial buildings, commercial buildings and development sites, externally validated against ISO 14064 on GHG verification.

rows.text: In February 2023, we were the first organisation to be verified by LRQA in Singapore for the indirect GHG emissions from products used in relation to its building construction projects in Singapore in accordance with category 4 of the ISO 14064-1:2018 standard.
rows.source_sentence: In February 2023, we were the first organisation to be verified by LRQA in Singapore for the indirect GHG emissions from products used in relation to its building construction projects in Singapore in accordance with category 4 of the ISO 14064-1:2018 standard.

rows.text: The Company’s climate-related targets such as those related to GHG emissions, water and energy usage, and waste generation, in line with regulatory and voluntary requirements, are published in our annual ISR.
rows.source_sentence: The Company’s climate-related targets such as those related to GHG emissions, water and energy usage, and waste generation, in line with regulatory and voluntary requirements, are published in our annual ISR.

rows.text: We established our first carbon emissions intensity reduction target in 2011 and voluntarily raised the target from 25% to 38% by 2030 (from 2007 levels) in 2017.
rows.source_sentence: We established our first carbon emissions intensity reduction target in 2011 and voluntarily raised the target from 25% to 38% by 2030 (from 2007 levels) in 2017.

rows.text: The company likely promotes tenant sustainability through green lease clauses and engagement programs, given its strong focus on climate resilience and green building practices in its portfolio.
